notes.title: ❓ ❔ 🐶 🚪

notes.title: Beach Volleyball is here! 🌊 🏖️
notes.content:
Ready to beach off your friends? Cause Beach Volleyball is here! 🌊 🏖️ 

Play the new Beach Off map and check out the new Beach cosmetics featured in the daily store!

Woah did slappyball get a job¹ ? Cause we got a new professional looking Title Screen!

notes.title: Black History Month & Custom Match fixes

notes.title: More Slapoween Cosmetics
notes.content:
Updated upcoming featured store items for Slapoween!
 Smoothed spectator movement for more cinematic shots.
 Added a warning if you play with a build too old for matchmaking.

notes.title: Slapoween & Ball 2.0
notes.content:
Ball 2.0 is here! For those on higher pings, the ball location should be more accurate and easier to hit.
 Matchmaking time before being placed into a botmatch has been reduced, let us know how it feels.
 The first round of Slapoween cosmetics have dropped. Plus, the agent decorated the locker room, check his hard work!
 While in a party, clicking quit to menu still keeps you with your party.

notes.title: The Pirate Invasion
notes.content:
Play on the New Pirate Ship Map!
 New single tiered free Slappypass with tons of stuff
 New featured items in the store every week
 Ranked removal for now, it'll be back soon in a new form.

notes.title: The Precursor To Season 1:Pirate’s Life
notes.content:
Improved hand skin look
 Reduced ball jitter and freezes at high ping
 Hands should never jitter at start of match
 Fixed extra character husks spawning in game

notes.title: New Ball Again? And Smooth Servers Baby
notes.content:
Ball 1.9: Here we go again. This time it's gonna work. Maybe.
 Improved performance when players join or leave mid-match
 Greatly reduced server lag in general
 Party issues going into Freeplay should be resolved
 Freeplay and Tutorial map visual adjustments

notes.title: Ball 1.8 is here!
notes.content:
Ball version 1.8 released. Further changes are coming but the core of the new ball is in. Let us know your thoughts!
 Backfill stopped if the match is more than half over
 Dive save improvements: more accurate with what is actually a save vs ends up as a scored point, can no longer be spammed
 Matchmaking is now retried multiple times before starting a local host match
 Various UI/UX fixes

notes.title: Some Pride Fits and Prep for Ball 2.0
notes.content:
First batch of Pride cosmetics are featured in the store! Pride is year round so we'll be extending past June and will have a few more things available in the coming weeks
 We're working hard on the backend to improve gameplay and network logic, focusing on a full ball revamp for how it syncs up with the server, more news on that soon

notes.title: Slappy Birthday!
notes.content:
Slappy Birthday Slappyball! You are one year old, we are so proud of you.

Thank you everyone who has been around for this past year, to all the new players who hopped on recently to the original group that know who Yumbo is. Slappyball hasn't made any giant splashes, but its thanks to the people sticking around its had its small little success on this corner of the internet.

Alright, enough sappy talk!

Get the new birthday hat from the Daily Store before it disappears.

You can now pick the number of points in a set for Custom Matches.

Reduced frequency of matchmaking join issues.

There are less shoe squeaks overall now, rejoice, the people who were getting really annoyed with that!

Players joining midmatch should no longer reset player positions.

notes.title: Bug Control
notes.content:
Some misc bug fixes here!

Fixed dribbling sound on replays.

Fixed wrong court size sometimes appearing on custom server match join.

Reduced instances of ball phasing through hand.

Fix for custom server popup for failure after match started.

notes.title: Ball Rotation
notes.content:
Ball changes and various fixes for y'all.

Reduced ball jitter that would occur frequently in certain matches.

Added proper ball rotation after every hit.

Reduced speed of L2 flip hits. Let us know how it feels or if there are other moves that are still too powerful.

[strike]Made a fix for players sometimes not joining server matches properly on start.[/strike]

Custom Server matches: Shuffle players now works properly.

notes.title: Competitive Dive Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Keep giving us feedback on the new dive, and tell us if you have anymore issues with these bugs.

Reduced range of the competitive dive assist.

Players will appear to teleport less often now on higher pings.

Fixed the ball sometimes not being hittable at serve line.

Corrected the color order for customizing items with controller.

Give us more information if you see anymore issues with the following:

Fix for ranked matchmaking entering an empty match when queuing for both ranked and casual

Fix for max number of players on server hosted custom limited to 6

Keep an eye out for the next build with a newly designed Daily Store with new cosmetics. And keep sending those bug reports in!

notes.title: Host your custom matches from any available servers now!
notes.content:
A mix of gameplay polish and new custom match features are in this update!

New Custom Match options, including flip and power up toggles, exact bot counts per team, and:

Premium players can host games on any available server in custom matches!

Option changes made by server host now shown to other players in lobby.

Players have more control over how far to dive based on how long the button is held, adjusted how dive assist works.

New competitive dive option used in ranked and as option in custom matches. Reduces amount of dive assist so that it requires more skill.

High latency games now handle double jumps and dives more consistently

Ball prediction code revamped again to be more responsive and accurate. This is a work in progress so let us know of any issues you have.

Please send in any feedback you have about the new competitive dive, the ball prediction, and if you have more options you would want for custom matches.

notes.title: Version .35 is live now!
notes.content:
Improved ball prediction and syncing when playing online matches. The ball location should now be more accurate and responsive

Improved performance in all 3 arenas. Estimated at more than 20% improvement in performance

Ball max speed limited to help avoid balls being impossible to hit. Future updates will further limit flip hits to not be overpowered

Reduced motion blur. We may introduce an option for increased motion blur in the future

Adjusted collision on top of colosseum poles

3 point max size slightly reduced, so even in high volley rounds there’s still strategy to positioning your hand

notes.title: Welcome to the Romehand Faire!
notes.content:
The Cyberpunk items are gone, and now we are going low tech with the Romehand Faire.

New Slappypass, new items. There are some new types of items available with this pass, get new team names, a new face, and tattoos.

Play matches on the Coliseum arena. Avoid the chariots racing around the edges, and make sure to put on a good show for the audience.

Overall leveling is now tracked properly outside of seasons.

If you haven't been here in awhile, we also have a brand new UI look and a Ranked mode option. Ranked rewards will be coming soon, so start getting matches in early.

Pssst, make sure to check out the 3v3 tournament coming up!

notes.title: Happy New Year and Goodbye to the Holiday Event
notes.content:
Holiday season fun is over (seasonal items removed) but look forward to Season 0.5 in two weeks! More info coming out tomorrow.

Changes

 Reduced server disconnects on start of match
 Opposing team corners’ teleportation consistency improved
 Slappypass can now be purchased with Slapphires

notes.title: Version .31 is out now with rank, jump boost, and quick chat changes!
notes.content:
Added new Diamond rank for top tier players - something to reach for past Gold III

3 Point jump boost now only triggered when holding down new boost button

Quick chat button now brings up a basic list of chat options, and the “I got it” “You get it” chats are only triggerable with the chat button held down

Added rank name next to icon in matchmaking menu

Dive assist disable option now actually turns off the assist

notes.title: Ranked Is Here
notes.content:
You asked for it, and now it is HERE! Pick between Casual and Ranked (or both!) when you queue up.

Ranked
There are three ranks you can get with this Early Access build: Bronze, Silver, and Gold. There won't be bots or backfilling for this game mode. Play five matches to get your initial rank and work on climbing up to Gold. For now, there is only one rank shared between 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3.

Visual Upgrade
Both the locker room and the UI have gotten an upgrade! This is a big step in looking more polished overall and we are so happy with the changes.

Additional Changes


 New mechanic: Jump pads and 3 point jump boost in the Cyberpunk arena
 More holiday cosmetics added

notes.title: Happy Slapsgiving and Handukkah
notes.content:
Dress up like a hand turkey or wear some Handukkah themed nails! More holiday items are coming soon.

Bug Fixes

 Updated Discord URL to work again
 Increased AFK kick time to 50 seconds

notes.title: Slappyball is under new management
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Slappyball is now being developed by a new team, Amelore. We are a small worker-owned game studio and we are so excited to bring this game to new heights. Here is a quick preview of everything we have in store for y'all:


THE FIRST UPDATE (Est. Later This Week)

Small performance update: frame rate limiting! Previously, it was unlimited and we have seen the complaints about high GPU usage even in menus.

No more lootboxes: The lootbox has been removed for now, Team Names are given on every level up.

New cosmetic: Tattoos will be added as a new cosmetic option to purchase.

Analytics: Data to help us make major game design decisions.

Logs: Phew, let's get some info from those crashes and see how we can fix them.

Leaderboards Fix: This may not make it into the FIRST UPDATE but if not, we will try to squeeze in a small patch inbetween. 


NEW QUEUES & BUG FIXES (Est. Mid-Late August)

 1v1 and 2v2 queues
 Freeplay while matchmaking
 Stadium Ads
 First round of bug fixing


SEASON 0 UPDATE (Est. September)

 Theme voted on by the community: Cyberpunk
 New Stadium & cosmetics
 Slappypass 0
 MMR + Ranked Play
 Further Matchmaking/Server Improvements
